methods.baseline:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
repo=/home/ativaro/Documents/tide
original=$(dirname "$(realpath "$0")")
w=$1
entry=$2
root=$3
obs=$4
stamp() { perl -MTime::HiRes=clock_gettime,CLOCK_MONOTONIC -e 'printf("%.9f\n",clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC))'; }
stamp > "$w/start"
args=$("$original/tide-args" "$entry" "$obs" "$w/checked" | jq -c --arg root "$root" '.root=$root')
printf '%s\n' "$args" > "$w/input"
checked=$(cat "$w/checked")
rev=$(jq -er .revision <<< "$checked")
payload=$(jq -nc --argjson input "$args" --argjson checked "$checked" '$input+{signatures:($checked.definitions|to_entries|map({name:.key,kind:.value.kind,signature:([.key]+[.value.params|to_entries[]|.key+":"+.value]+[">",.value.returns]|join(" "))}))}')
"$repo/tide" run "$repo/workbench/grouping.tide" --call prepare_grouping --inputs "$payload" > "$w/plan"
if [[ ${5:-} == source_repair ]]; then
  payload=$(jq -c '.packet+{queries}' "$w/plan")
  "$repo/tide" run "$repo/workbench/source_repair.tide" --call source_repair --inputs "$payload" > "$w/source"
  jq -c .forms "$w/source" > "$w/forms"
  jq -c .view "$w/source" > "$w/grouped"
  exit 0
fi
jq -c .packet "$w/plan" > "$w/packet"
jq -c .unused "$w/plan" > "$w/unused"
base=$(basename -- "$entry")
stamp > "$w/forms-start"
jq -r '.queries[] | [.name,.file,.line,.column] | @tsv' "$w/plan" |
while IFS=$'\t' read -r name file line column; do
  if [[ $column == 0 ]]; then
    node=$("$repo/tide" context "$entry" --function "$name" |
      jq -er --arg rev "$rev" 'if .revision==$rev then .nodes[0].node else error("project revision changed") end')
  else
    node="$line:$column"
    if [[ $file != "$base" ]]; then node="$file:$node"; fi
  fi
  "$repo/tide" context "$entry" --function "$name" --node "$node" |
    jq -ce --arg rev "$rev" --arg file "$file" 'if .revision==$rev then {name:.definition,$file,body:.selection.expanded} else error("project revision changed") end'
done | jq -sc . > "$w/forms"
stamp > "$w/forms-end"
view=$(jq -c --slurpfile forms "$w/forms" '.+{forms:$forms[0]}' "$w/packet")
"$repo/tide" run "$repo/workbench/grouped_view.tide" --call "${5:-compiler_view}" --inputs "$view" > "$w/grouped"
stamp > "$w/end"

"$repo/tide" run "$repo/workbench/grouping.tide" --call prepare_grouping --inputs "$payload" > "$w/plan"
if [[ ${5:-} == source_repair ]]; then
  payload=$(jq -c '.packet+{queries}' "$w/plan")
  "$repo/tide" run "$repo/workbench/source_repair.tide" --call source_repair --inputs "$payload" > "$w/source"
  jq -c .forms "$w/source" > "$w/forms"
  jq -c .view "$w/source" > "$w/grouped"
  exit 0
fi
jq -c .packet "$w/plan" > "$w/packet"
jq -c .unused "$w/plan" > "$w/unused"
base=$(basename -- "$entry")
stamp > "$w/forms-start"
jq -jr '[.packet.files[].source] | join("\n\n")' "$w/plan" |
  "$repo/tide" forms > "$w/forms.tsv"
jq -ce --rawfile table "$w/forms.tsv" '
  ($table | split("\n") | map(select(length > 0) | split("\t"))) as $rows |
  INDEX($rows[]; .[0]) as $by_name |
  if ($rows|all(length == 2)) and ($rows|length) == ($by_name|length)
     and (.queries|length) == ($rows|length) and (.queries|map(.name)|unique|length) == ($rows|length)
  then [.queries[] | . as $q | ($by_name[$q.name][1] // error("missing grouped function")) as $body |
        {name:$q.name,file:$q.file,$body}]
  else error("inconsistent grouped functions") end' "$w/plan" > "$w/forms"
stamp > "$w/forms-end"
view=$(jq -c --slurpfile forms "$w/forms" '.+{forms:$forms[0]}' "$w/packet")
"$repo/tide" run "$repo/workbench/grouped_view.tide" --call "${5:-compiler_view}" --inputs "$view" > "$w/grouped"
stamp > "$w/end"
methods.tide-args:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
entry=$1
obs=$2
tide=/home/ativaro/Documents/tide/tide
dir=$(dirname -- "$entry")
checked=$("$tide" check "$entry")
printf '%s\n' "$checked" > "$3"
{ basename -- "$entry"; jq -r '.modules[]' <<< "$checked"; } |
while IFS= read -r file; do
  jq -n --arg file "$file" --rawfile source "$dir/$file" '{file:$file,source:$source}'
done |
jq -cs --arg observation "$obs" --argjson checked "$checked" '{root:"main", $observation, graph:($checked.definitions|to_entries|map({name:.key,calls:.value.calls})),units:.}'
